name: autofix
description: Option C fix pipeline (v3): fix-dev writes the fix AND the tests, gated by its OWN strong check -- green + coverage-not-dropped + no test deleted/skipped/reduced + new/changed behaviour tests RED on the pre-fix source -- which now runs in a git worktree of the base, so a failure feeds straight back into the agent loop. An independent test-auditor then files a PASS/FAIL on test weakening the mechanical check can't see. Per-run cache. Inputs {task, namespace, repo, ref}.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: the PR branch to fix (base for coverage + regression proof)

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: the pull request number this fix belongs to (provenance)

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}"; git rev-parse HEAD > /workspace/.fixbase; echo "working on branch ${inputs.ref}:"; git log --oneline -1

set +e; export HOME=/tmp; [ -n "$NUM" ] || { echo 'no PR number; skip announce'; exit 0; }; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; RID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '
' | grep ""name":"$REPO"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1); mkdir -p /tmp/jw; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/jw/main.go; cd /tmp/jw && printf 'module jw

go 1.25
' > go.mod; FIRST=$(printf '%s' "$TASK" | head -1); printf '🔧 **Fixing:** %s

The commits below address this finding.' "$FIRST" > /tmp/body.txt; go run . /tmp/body.txt > /tmp/body.json; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/body.json || echo 000); echo "announce -> $code"; exit 0

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/${inputs.ref}"); mkdir -p .review; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- '*_test.go' > .review/tests.diff; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- '*.go' ':(exclude)*_test.go' > .review/code.diff; git add -A .review; git -c user.email=prepdiff@forge.cicd -c user.name=prepdiff commit -q -m 'chore(review): audit diff snapshots' || true; echo "tests.diff $(wc -l < .review/tests.diff) lines; code.diff $(wc -l < .review/code.diff) lines"

with.task: Audit the test changes for the fix of this finding. Read .review/tests.diff and .review/code.diff. Finding: ${inputs.task}

with.run: set -e; cd /workspace; [ -f AUDIT.md ] || { echo 'AUDIT FAIL: no AUDIT.md verdict'; exit 1; }; echo '=== AUDIT.md ==='; cat AUDIT.md; echo '==='; if head -1 AUDIT.md | grep -qE '^VERDICT: PASS'; then echo 'AUDIT OK'; exit 0; fi; echo 'AUDIT FAIL: auditor flagged weakened/bypassed tests'; exit 1

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/${inputs.ref}"); echo '=== STAT ==='; git diff --stat "$BASE" HEAD -- . ':(exclude).review'; echo '=== DIFF ==='; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- . ':(exclude).review' ':(exclude)STRENGTH.md' | head -450; echo '=== STRENGTH.md ==='; cat STRENGTH.md 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== AUDIT.md ==='; cat AUDIT.md 2>/dev/null || true

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; REF='${inputs.ref}'; git rm -q -r --ignore-unmatch .review AUDIT.md STRENGTH.md >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; git -c user.email=publish@forge.cicd -c user.name=publish commit -q -am 'chore: drop review artifacts' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no fix commits -- nothing to push'; fixed=0; export fixed; echo "fixed=$fixed"; exit 0; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$REF; echo "pushed the fix to $REF"; fixed=1; export fixed; echo "fixed=$fixed"

set +e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; [ -n "$NUM" ] || { echo 'no PR number; skip done'; exit 0; }; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; RID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '
' | grep ""name":"$REPO"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1); SHA=$(cd /workspace && git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ "$FIXED" = "1" ]; then printf '✅ **Fixed** — pushed `%s` (commits above).' "$SHA" > /tmp/body.txt; else printf '⚠️ **No change** for this finding — the autofixer could not resolve it.' > /tmp/body.txt; fi; mkdir -p /tmp/jw; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/jw/main.go; cd /tmp/jw && printf 'module jw

go 1.25
' > go.mod; go run . /tmp/body.txt > /tmp/body.json; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/body.json || echo 000); echo "done -> $code"; exit 0
